title: manager setup · Assign planner to define a bounded research protocol for comparing dyn
summary: Assign planner to define a bounded research protocol for comparing dynamic vs. static agent memory under fixed token budgets, adhering to strict audit rules.
body: Previous loops failed to find empirical data comparing dynamic memory consolidation against static baselines (e.g., append-only) under identical token constraints. Sources lacked direct baseline comparisons or resource constraint matching. The planner must now design a bounded research task targeting specific benchmarks with reproducible metrics (task success, hallucination rates) to empirically evaluate memory policies without code execution. Adhere strictly to auditable stopping rules (e.g., max 4 sources). If a hypothesis requires an experimental condition that no existing study satisfies, revise the task to match available evidence rather than forcing a fit. Do not infer superiority without controlled comparisons.
